design: Independent closed D-clamp hub plus removable positively retaining gear
scope: Nominal CAD contact, material support and sampled insertion/escape constraints, not physical qualification.

checks.test: Bare P05B permits clamp nut side loading from positive Y
Bare P05B permits M3x8 axial loading from positive X
Both joining nuts side-load normally with P05A removed
Bare hub and loaded nuts lower onto D shaft before gear installation
checks.scope: Undeformed reference fit; actual D-clamp deformation and holding torque require testing.

checks.test: P05A descends over clamped nominal hub and both joining nuts
checks.warning: The hub is undeformed in this check. Print fit after physical clamp tightening must be verified.

checks.test: All three M3 nuts have full 2.4mm nominal shank coverage
Common-size 2mm L-key references enter, tighten and reindex with cover installed

phases.phase: Descend from above while axially retracted
Set starting angle 60deg outside screw socket
Engage at 60deg using hex symmetry
Tightening stroke 60deg to 0deg, screw co-rotates
Withdraw axially while screw stays at -60deg
Reset to 60deg after disengagement
Re-engage for the next tightening stroke
Opposite-side -60deg sweep with screw co-rotating
Descend from above while axially retracted
Set starting angle 60deg outside screw socket
Engage at 60deg using hex symmetry
Tightening stroke 60deg to 0deg, screw co-rotates
Withdraw axially while screw stays at -60deg
Reset to 60deg after disengagement
Re-engage for the next tightening stroke
Opposite-side -60deg sweep with screw co-rotating

Set starting angle 60deg outside screw socket
Engage at 60deg using hex symmetry

checks.permitted_stroke: 60deg toward 0deg, long arm remains above cover; reset only while disengaged.
checks.assembly_order: Install P02A and motor first, fit P05B and clamp with L key, then fit P05A and finally P04.
checks.warning: Only the stated tool envelopes are validated. Catalog outside length differs from tip-to-stem centre distance; real bend radius, longer-arm obstruction and commercial dimensions require trial fitting. No screw preload/torque result.

checks.test: Joining screws have ordinary vertical tool access before P04
Closed cone supports all 360deg at four axial stations
checks.scope: Complete geometric bearing-seat material adjacent to nominal cone; no contact pressure/preload result.

checks.test: Closed 3.4mm guide rings remain around the clamp screw
checks.warning: A closed guide still has 0.2mm nominal radial clearance; this is not a zero-play claim.

checks.test: Gear skirt positively blocks side exits; removing gear restores access
Thread-engaged clamp screw/nut pair cannot translate out axially sideways or vertically
checks.scope: Rigid pair represents maintained thread engagement; six straight escape paths, not exhaustive arbitrary configuration-space search.

checks.test: Seated bolt pitch and yaw meet solid support rather than an open U slot
checks.warning: Tests start from the nominal seated cone; does not eliminate guide clearances or simulate elastic deflection and clamp force.

checks.test: D-clamp slit remains open through positive-Y flange perimeter
checks.warning: Closing deformation and whether gear attachment changes shaft grip require physical testing.

checks.test: Complete undeformed P05 unit clears cover and motor throughout rotation
checks.warning: Discrete undeformed geometry; not a continuous sweep or measured manufactured clearance.

checks.test: Original 30T tooth profile and 2:1 transmission remain unchanged
P05A change only fills the intended negative-Y crescent inside the old cavity
checks.scope: Unengraved CAD comparison; outer teeth, skirt, fixing bores and seats are unchanged.

checks.test: P05A D-cavity flat follows the unchanged P05B flat with 0.2mm nominal clearance
checks.warning: Nominal clearance, not an interference fit. Printed first-layer expansion and clamp deformation still need fitting.

checks.test: New side flat and both 45deg external chamfers are present
checks.scope: Only exterior material removal plus recessed identifier; tiny 0.02mm junction ledges are intentional.

checks.test: Exterior printing cuts preserve D-bore fit and closed bearing support
checks.warning: 1.65/2.15mm values are local axial-end back walls, not whole-part minimum thickness. Horizontal D/round holes still need slicer bridging/fit checks. The full cone/guide tests above are independently re-executed.

checks.test: Both P05 parts have real planar print-bed contact
checks.warning: P05B lies on the new side flat, not its original bottom. Hole roofs need local bridging/support checks; no support-free claim.

diagnostics.method: Straight axial screwdriver after P02A installation
diagnostics.reason: The fixed cover outer rim obstructs a straight axial approach. Use the tested L-key procedure; do not postpone cover installation around the already clamped flange.

limitations: No measured preload, clamping force, friction, thread lead, durability or vibration test.
Hub deformation after tightening and fit after gear attachment are not modeled.
Blocked sampled straight/tilt paths do not prove all possible arbitrary escape configurations.
Maintain screw/nut thread engagement; completely disassembling fasteners changes their constraints.
Print tolerance, cone seating, commercial tool dimensions and local support need trial fitting.
